runtime.identity: synthetic local fixture authenticated through the visible Account consent/login UI

sequences.purpose: A failed send retains exact user text and a retry produces one authoritative server message.
steps: Enter the message through the native textarea.
Redirect the local API origin to the unused loopback port 9 and submit.
Verify the draft and visible failure remain.
Restore the loopback acceptance API and trigger retry.
Verify the draft/error clear only after the server acknowledgement.
sequences.injectedCondition: Loopback port 9 network fault only; labelled synthetic and restored before retry.

sequences.role: authenticated synthetic member plus synthetic authorized operator
sequences.purpose: Polling must not pull a member away from history; the new-message notice survives later empty polls.
steps: Load 18 real acceptance-API history messages and start at the latest message.
Scroll the native thread upward so atBottom is false.
Send an operator reply through the real local API.
Wait for the incremental poll and capture the new-message notice.
Wait through another empty poll and verify the notice persists.
Tap the notice and verify the thread reaches the latest message.

sequences.purpose: A valid quote survives ordinary navigation, becomes recoverable after expiry, and can be requoted without losing the selected address.
steps: Create a quote through the real local API.
Navigate to address management and return.
Verify quote, countdown and selected address are retained.
Advance only the fixture clock beyond quote expiry.
Verify the native action becomes 重新确认价格 rather than a disabled dead end.
Request a new server quote and verify the same address remains selected.
sequences.injectedCondition: Synthetic clock advance only; quote creation and requote are real local API operations.

sequences.purpose: Background return and a remote revision cannot silently overwrite unsaved product edits.
steps: Enter a local product-name edit through the native input.
Background the editor with dirty=true.
Update the server product revision through the real local API.
Return and verify conflict=true, save disabled and the local draft unchanged.
Choose the keep-local resolution and verify the draft is rebased onto the latest server revision.

sequences.purpose: Composer height, thread inset and new-message control track multiline input without overlap.
steps: Capture the resting one-line composer.
Enter three lines through native input and dispatch the line-change measurement.
Measure the composer, scroll thread and new-message inset.

sequences.role: synthetic product operator whose three product capabilities are revoked
sequences.purpose: A hidden editor must fail closed and scrub its private draft after capability loss.
steps: Create a dirty product draft through the native input.
Hide the editor.
Revoke product, qualification and inventory capabilities in the disposable local database.
Return and capture the permission-loss transition.
Verify redirect to profile and absence of product or draft data.
sequences.injectedCondition: Three capability rows were revoked in the disposable local database; this is an authoritative local permission change, not page setData state fabrication.
